note: Fact templates for the scenario compiler. {TOKEN} and {token} are a generated word pair in upper and lower case, {alt}, {ALT}, and {Alt} a second word in lower, upper, and Pascal case, {value} and {value2} distinct five-digit numbers, and {codename} an adjective-noun-NN codename. A template's variants list binds further placeholders, one entry per instance in turn. When a template repeats in one project, the later instance is conveyed through revise, whose {old_*} placeholders name the previous instance's values. A check's must and must_not regexes apply to the added lines of the agent's diff, paths_must and paths_must_not to the paths of the files the diff adds or changes, first_line_must to the first line of every file the diff adds, quote_style_must (double or single) to the delimiter of every string literal in the added lines, commands_must and commands_must_not to the command log, an optional scope (a directory prefix ending in /, or one file path) restricts a check's diff-channel keys to files under that prefix or to that file, and an optional applies lists regexes for the constructs a rule governs (a new public constant, a returned error string, a log call): each match in the scoped added lines, extended over its open brackets, is one unit, and the rule holds only when a unit exists and every unit matches every must regex; and answer, answer_must_not, abstain, and judge checks to the final assistant text of the agent call record the proxy captures. A plan template names a task; the compiler composes plan statements from one or two tasks. A tool_error template has form tool_result (a committed script the agent runs) or pasted (a failure transcript the user pastes). Every rust and typescript template carries requires, the constructs its tasks presuppose: each entry names a file path and a regex that the file must match at the pinned commit of every repository of that language and of its twin; the compiler refuses a bank whose requirement a pinned tree lacks.
